title: Connector record
description: The connector's local record for one paired hub, at ~/.web-chat/connector/<hub-id>.json (mode 0600, directory 0700), written atomically as lib/core/fsjson writes registry files. Never sent to the hub as a whole; the hub learns only what contract 05 messages carry. Its absolute path is handed to each daemon the connector spawns as the environment variable WEB_CHAT_CONNECTOR_RECORD (a path, not a secret; C-06.19), and such a daemon reads only `ceiling` from it, following the file through lib/core/watch (C-06.23a). The private key is NOT in this file: it lives beside it at ~/.web-chat/connector/<hub-id>.key (0600). No relay secret is in this file or any other: each one travels to its daemon on fd 3 at spawn (C-06.7, C-06.19). Times are epoch milliseconds, as web-chat's registry rows use (lib/util/registry.js).

v.description: Record format version. A connector that reads a higher v refuses to run and says which build wrote it.

hub.description: The hub this record pairs with.

id.description: The hub's id as contract 05's hello names it; also the file name of this record and of the key.

origin.description: The hub's https origin, as typed to `claude-web-chat connect <hub>` and normalised. The connector dials only this origin.

name.description: Display name the hub gave itself, for CLI output only.

machine.description: This machine as the hub registered it at pairing; null before pairing completes.

id.description: The hub-minted machine id (contract 03 section 2: mch_ and 26 lowercase Crockford base32 characters).

name.description: The name the user gave the machine on the hub.

credential.description: The machine key pair's public half and pairing state. Algorithm and handshake are contract 05's.

state.description: unpaired: no key yet; pending: a pairing code is shown and not yet confirmed; paired: the hub holds the public key; revoked: the hub or `connect disconnect` revoked it and the key file is deleted.

algorithm.description: Key algorithm. ed25519 is the proposal; contract 05 may widen the enum.

key_file.description: Absolute path of the private key file (PKCS#8 PEM, mode 0600). Never logged, never sent.

key_id.description: The key's id as pairing or rotation returned it (contract 03 section 2, prefix mky; 05 C-05.3, C-05.7). Sent in auth.response.

public_key.description: The public key in contract 03's wire form (C-03.8): the raw 32 bytes, base64url without padding.

fingerprint.description: Contract 03's display form (C-03.8): `SHA256:` and the unpadded base64 of SHA-256 over the raw key, shown by `connect status` and on the hub's machine page so a user can compare them.

revoked_at.description: When the credential was revoked, if it was.

workdir.description: Absolute directory the connector owns for repo clones and space directories (default ~/web-chat-hub/<hub-id>), mode 0700, never inside ~/.web-chat and never inside an offered folder; no offered folder may contain it (C-06.13, C-06.18). Its paths are never reported to the hub.

ceiling.description: The machine's ceiling (contract 04 C-04.11, a MUST under OQ-1's ruling B; contract 06 C-06.23a): the most any hub principal reaches on this machine's chats. One value per machine in v1, applying to every offered folder and owned root. Absent means full. Pairing and `connect offer` write the default and never change a value the user set; `connect ceiling <read|full>` sets it at the machine, and no hub frame does. A daemon the connector spawned takes the lesser of X-WC-Level and this value, only beside the relay credential (03 C-03.21).

settings.description: The machine settings the hub sets (contract 05 carries them) as last received, plus the one local ceiling. The connector enforces them while offline from the hub too.

agents_at_once.description: The hub's agents-at-once cap for this machine.

local_cap.description: A local cap set on the machine with `connect cap <n>`; the effective cap is the lesser of this and agents_at_once. Null: no local cap. Not the level ceiling, which is the top-level `ceiling`.

accept_new_chats.description: False: new assignments are refused (reason not-accepting); chats already here are unaffected.

let_home_start_agents.description: False: an assignment asking for a connector-launched session is refused (reason home-launch-off); manual sessions are unaffected.

paused.description: True: deliveries and launches only (W3; C-06.23, contract 05 C-05.27): the hub sends no delivery and the connector launches no session; running turns finish, daemons stay up, the framed composer still queues, Send now and an immediate signal still wake the agent, and the chat can still be stopped.

rev.description: The hub's revision of these settings; an older revision is ignored.

folders.description: Folders offered on this machine with `connect offer <path>`. The only paths the hub ever learns.

chats.description: Every chat assigned to this machine and the local root it maps to.

service.description: The start-at-login unit `connect` installed, or null when it runs in the foreground only.

kind.description: launchd: a per-user LaunchAgent on macOS; systemd-user: a systemd user unit on Linux.

label.description: The launchd Label or systemd unit name.

unit_path.description: Absolute path of the plist or unit file.

path_env.description: The PATH written into the unit, captured at install so the service finds node, git, tmux and claude.

installed_at.description: When the unit was last written.

last_reported.description: What the connector last reported about itself (contract 05 carries it; contract 12 negotiates versions).

connector_version.description: packageVersion() of the build the connector process runs (lib/core/versions.js).

claude_code_version.description: `claude --version`, run through lib/core/claude-cli.js; null when claude is not found.

folder.description: One offered folder. Contract 05's machine report carries these objects by $ref, unchanged.

id.description: Stable id minted at random on the machine when the folder is offered; never derived from the path.

display.description: The path for display, with the home directory shown as ~ (the form lib/core/paths.js redactHostPaths uses; contract 11 C-11.6). The hub shows this beside the id.

access.description: What a chat may do in the folder. v1 has read-write only; read-only is deferred.

chat.description: One chat assigned here and its local root.

chat_id.description: The chat label (contract 03 section 2): the chat id without its cht_ prefix, as every 05 frame names a chat and as the chat-<label> origins carry it.

scope_kind.description: The chat's scope kind, from the assignment.

folder_id.description: For a folder chat: the offered folder it uses.

root.description: The chat root: the absolute directory its daemon is rooted at.

instance.description: instanceId(root) (lib/util/registry.js), cross-checked against the daemon's GET /api/health `instance`.

owned_root.description: True when the connector made the root (a clone or a space) under workdir. stop_mode now and disconnect shut down any daemon on an owned root, whatever its started_by (C-06.22, C-06.9); a daemon adopted here is still started_by other until the connector's idle restart (C-06.19).

desired.description: The hub's last desired state for the chat's daemon.

manual_attach_at.description: When `connect attach` first ran a session in this root; null before. Connector mode is offered for the root only once this is set, because a manual session is where the user answers Claude Code's workspace trust dialog (C-06.26, reason needs-trust). Only the manual attach sets it: a registry MCP row (mcpSessionsFor) proves only that the MCP server loaded, not that the dialog was passed.

assigned_at.description: When the chat was first assigned here.
